content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Research Associate-III Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Research Associate-III position at AIIMS Jodhpur is scheduled for 24 August 2026. Candidates are advised to report to the venue well in advance.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate-III post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D./MD/MS/MDS or equivalent degree, or MVSc/M.Pharm/ME/M.Tech/M.Sc with at least 3 years of research experience and one research paper in a Science Citation Indexed (SCI) Journal.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Associate-III position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate-III post is 35 years. Age relaxation may be provided to SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate-III post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Associate-III position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 67,000 per month, plus HRA.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate-III post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Associate-III position at AIIMS Jodhpur.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Research Associate-III post?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve an interview. A screening test may be conducted if there is a large number of candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at All India Institute of Medical Sciences Jodhpur, Rajasthan. The exact venue details will be available in the official notification.
